test_sparse_array_numeric_arithmetic: test numeric arithmetic operations between sparse arrays and scalars or dense arrays
test_sparse_array_comparison_ops: test comparison operators (==, !=, >=, <=, >, <) between sparse arrays and dense values
test_sparse_array_logical_ops: test logical bitwise operators (&, |) between boolean sparse arrays
test_sparse_array_ufuncs: test numpy ufuncs (np.abs, np.exp, np.add, np.greater) on sparse arrays
test_sparse_array_inplace_operations: test inplace arithmetic operations (+=) between sparse and dense arrays
